title: 2025 Snowball Derby Qualifying Order Set - NewsBreak
text:
By Koty Geyer ,
1 hours ago 2025 Snowball Derby Qualifying Order Set The order for Friday night’s Snowball Derby and Saturday afternoon’s Allen Turner Hyundai Snowflake 125 qualifying sessions were decided Wednesday night during the qualifying draw at Five Flags Speedway.
Max Reaves will be the first driver to take the track for qualifying tomorrow night in his maiden Snowball Derby appearance. In what’s been a trend in recent years, Ty Majeski goes out early once again after drawing number three, just behind fellow Wisconsin driver Derek Kraus. Other notables include Erik Jones (6th), Ryan Preece (16th), Noah Gragson (21st), Stephen Nasse (29th), Derek Thorn (33rd), Bubba Pollard (34th), Kaden Honeycutt (37th), and Kyle Busch (38th).
On the Pro Late Model side, Nashville Fairgrounds Speedway regular Corey Deuser will kick off Snowflake 125 qualifying ahead of Donald Crocker and Keelan Harvick. Defending race winner Stephen Nasse will go out 10th, while former winners Bubba Pollard (43rd) and Casey Roderick (50th) will take their times later in the session.
In a stroke of coincidence, Jake Finch will be the last car to qualify in both Snowball Derby and Snowflake sessions.
